why: Both analyses land on the same hedgehog (wireless leadership through self-obsolescence, not size), the same stop-doing items (doubling goal, ungated satellite launch, analog defense, coercive distribution) and the same brutal facts. Analysis 1 places the company more precisely at late Stage 1, inside Stage 2 and on the edge of Stage 3, names the outside-saviour and pricing-pressure-blame risks, and gives a tighter verdict, while Analysis 2 passes its own Discipline gate despite the drift it documents.
